title: Follow a partner's palm
description: Keep your palm a short distance from a partner's palm as they move.
oneStarDescription: Agree the gap aloud and hold your palm at that distance before either of you moves.
twoStarDescription: Follow for a few moves without touching.
threeStarDescription: Stop in the same moment they stop, without closing the gap.

title: Fret a note and name the fret
description: Press one fret, sound the string, and say the fret number.
oneStarDescription: Point to the fret before you press.
twoStarDescription: Press just behind the fret and pluck.
threeStarDescription: Lift the finger and show the string open.

title: Gather a cloth edge
description: Sew a running stitch on scrap and pull it so the edge gathers.
oneStarDescription: Sew a loose running stitch along an edge.
twoStarDescription: Pull the thread so the cloth gathers.
threeStarDescription: Slide the gathers so they are not all in one lump.

title: Hang trousers so the creases match
description: Hang trousers so the legs lie together and the waist is supported.
oneStarDescription: Lay the inner seams together.
twoStarDescription: Put them on a bar or a hanger.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the hems hang level.

title: Hinge a photo on a page
description: Attach a photo or a scrap print with a hinge so you can lift it.
oneStarDescription: Fasten only one edge. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can hinge one edge.
twoStarDescription: Lift the photo and lay it back.
threeStarDescription: Show that the face has no adhesive on the picture.

title: Hit a mark and turn
description: Walk to a mark on the floor, stop, and turn to a named direction.
oneStarDescription: Point to the mark before you walk.
twoStarDescription: Stop with a foot on the mark.
threeStarDescription: Turn to the direction you named.

title: Hit a paper target with a band
description: Shoot a rubber band at a paper target and say whether you hit the mark you drew.
oneStarDescription: Draw a mark on paper and set it up.
twoStarDescription: Release one band toward the paper.
threeStarDescription: Say whether you hit the mark.

title: Hold a still pose
description: Hold a pose while someone walks around you, and say what moved.
oneStarDescription: Choose a pose you can hold.
twoStarDescription: Hold it while they walk to one side.
threeStarDescription: Name one thing that moved, or say you stayed still.

title: Hop a band between fingers
description: Move a rubber band from one pair of fingers to another with a hop the watcher can see.
oneStarDescription: Put the band on two fingers.
twoStarDescription: Move it to the other pair in one motion.
threeStarDescription: Repeat it slowly enough that someone sees the start and the end.

title: Hop a paper frog
description: Fold a paper frog, press the back, and show a hop.
oneStarDescription: Fold a frog that sits. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can fold the frog.
twoStarDescription: Press and slide off so it moves.
threeStarDescription: Let someone see it leave the table or say it only twitched.

title: Hum a note and stop on a sign
description: Hum one note and stop when a partner raises a hand.
oneStarDescription: Hum one steady note. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can hold a note.
twoStarDescription: Watch the other person and stop the note when they give the sign you agreed.
threeStarDescription: Stop when the hand goes up.

title: Invent a harmless code
description: Invent a code for five letters, write the key, and decode a word with it.
oneStarDescription: Write five letters and their signs.
twoStarDescription: Encode one word. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can encode.
threeStarDescription: Decode it from the key without looking at the word.

title: Juggle two balls in one hand
description: Keep two balls moving in one hand, separate from a three-ball pattern.
oneStarDescription: Throw one ball and catch it in the same hand.
twoStarDescription: Keep both balls moving in that hand.
threeStarDescription: Catch both and show the other hand was empty.

title: Label a jar so the tape peels
description: Label a jar with tape you can peel off without leaving the jar for someone else to scrape.
oneStarDescription: Write what is in the jar, or a practice word.
twoStarDescription: Stick it on the jar. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can attach it.
threeStarDescription: Peel it off and show the jar.

title: Label the back of a print
description: Write a date and a short title on the back of a print with a pencil.
oneStarDescription: Turn the print over and point to the back, not the image.
twoStarDescription: Write the date and a few words lightly.
threeStarDescription: Look at the face and say whether the writing dented it.

title: Land a ball in a cup
description: Swing a tethered ball into a cup and leave it there.
oneStarDescription: Show the cup and the ball on its string.
twoStarDescription: Swing the ball into the cup and stop.
threeStarDescription: Hold still so someone can see the ball stayed in.

title: Land a bottle upright
description: Flip a partly filled plastic bottle so it lands upright and stays.
oneStarDescription: Show the bottle partly filled and capped.
twoStarDescription: Flip it once so it lands upright.
threeStarDescription: Leave it standing long enough for someone to see.

title: Link two clips with a fold
description: Fold a strip so two paperclips link when you pull the ends, then show the fold.
oneStarDescription: Clip them on a strip in the setup you can redraw.
twoStarDescription: Pull the ends and show the clips linked, or say they did not.
threeStarDescription: Unfold a second strip and show where each clip sat.

title: Link items in a story
description: Remember eight ordinary items by linking them in one story, then recall them without the list.
oneStarDescription: Tell a story that includes the eight items in order.
twoStarDescription: Recall the eight without looking, and mark a miss.
threeStarDescription: Put the missed item back into the story and recall that part.

title: Link two rubber bands
description: Link two rubber bands into a chain that holds a light tug.
oneStarDescription: Pass one band through the other.
twoStarDescription: Pull so they sit as a chain.
threeStarDescription: Tug lightly and show they stayed linked.

title: Make a box divider
description: Fold a divider that splits a box into two spaces a small object cannot cross.
oneStarDescription: Mark the width the divider must span.
twoStarDescription: Put it in so it stands. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can fit it.
threeStarDescription: Put a small object on one side and tip the box slightly.

title: Make a cat's cradle
description: Take a string loop from open hands to a cradle, then back to open hands.
oneStarDescription: Hold the loop across both hands.
twoStarDescription: Move to one cradle figure.
threeStarDescription: Return the string to a simple loop.

title: Make a corner bookmark
description: Make a corner bookmark and fit it on a page.
oneStarDescription: Make the pocket that takes a page corner.
twoStarDescription: Put it on a page corner.
threeStarDescription: Turn the page and show the bookmark stayed or say it slipped.

title: Make a neck rest from a scarf
description: Roll a scarf into a rest you can put behind your neck and then unroll.
oneStarDescription: Roll the scarf. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can roll it.
twoStarDescription: Put it behind the neck and say whether it stays for a moment.
threeStarDescription: Unroll it so it is a scarf again.

title: Make a paper accordion book
description: Fold a strip into an accordion and stand it so two pages show.
oneStarDescription: Fold the strip into even pages.
twoStarDescription: Stand it so it holds open.
threeStarDescription: Fold one page over and show the next.

title: Make a paper beard
description: Cut a paper beard, try it on, and take it off.
oneStarDescription: Cut a beard shape with a way to hold it.
twoStarDescription: Hold it in place. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can try it on.
threeStarDescription: Take it off and show it is one piece.

title: Make a paper claw that grabs
description: Fold a paper claw, open it, and pick up a light ball of paper.
oneStarDescription: Fold a claw you can open.
twoStarDescription: Open it and close it on the paper ball.
threeStarDescription: Lift the ball clear of the table, or say it slipped.

title: Make a compass rose you can turn
description: Draw a compass rose, label the four directions, and turn it to match a known north.
oneStarDescription: Write north, east, south, and west.
twoStarDescription: Turn the paper so north matches a north you were given or a compass you may use.
threeStarDescription: Name what lies to the east of you on that orientation.

title: Fold a cube from a net
description: Cut or use a cube net, fold it, and show a closed cube.
oneStarDescription: Count the six faces before you fold.
twoStarDescription: Fold it into a cube. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can fold it.
threeStarDescription: Tuck the last face and show it stays, or say which tab failed.

title: Make a paper pocket
description: Fold a paper pocket that holds a card.
oneStarDescription: Fold a pocket with one open side.
twoStarDescription: Slide a card inside. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can use it.
threeStarDescription: Turn it over and say whether the card fell.

title: Make a paper spring
description: Fold or cut a paper spring that stretches and returns.
oneStarDescription: Make a spring from paper.
twoStarDescription: Stretch it and let it return, or say it tore.
threeStarDescription: Hang a light clip on it and say whether it held.

title: Make a paper whistle
description: Fold a paper whistle, blow one note, and stop.
oneStarDescription: Fold a whistle that has a way for air to leave.
twoStarDescription: Blow one note that a person nearby can hear, then stop.
threeStarDescription: Stop and flatten it, or say you will keep it.

title: Make a pinwheel that spins
description: Make a paper pinwheel and show it spinning when you blow or walk.
oneStarDescription: Pin or fasten the pinwheel so it can turn.
twoStarDescription: Blow or walk and show it turn.
threeStarDescription: If it does not turn, point to the part that catches.

title: Make a pom-pom that holds
description: Make a yarn pom-pom and show it holds together when you shake it.
oneStarDescription: Wrap yarn and tie the middle.
twoStarDescription: Cut the loops and fluff it.
threeStarDescription: Shake it once and say whether yarn fell out.

title: Make a pop-up fold
description: Make one pop-up fold inside a card so a tab stands when the card opens.
oneStarDescription: Make one tab in the fold.
twoStarDescription: Open it and show the tab standing.
threeStarDescription: Close the card flat again.

title: Make a rainbow with a glass and a lamp
description: Use a glass of water and a lamp to cast a colored patch, and point to the colors you see.
oneStarDescription: Aim a lamp, not the sun, through or past the glass.
twoStarDescription: Point to a colored patch on a wall or paper.
threeStarDescription: Name one color you can see in it.

title: Make a silhouette
description: Place a lamp so a profile becomes a dark shape on a wall, and trace it if you may.
oneStarDescription: Put the lamp so the shadow edge is clear.
twoStarDescription: Point to the nose and the chin in the shadow.
threeStarDescription: Trace it on paper if you may, or say you only looked.

title: Make a soap film on a loop
description: Dip a paper or wire loop in soapy water and show a film, then pop it on purpose.
oneStarDescription: Show a closed loop with no break in the rim.
twoStarDescription: Lift the loop with a film across it.
threeStarDescription: Pop the film and show the empty loop.

title: Make a note on a straw
description: Cut a straw end, blow one note, and shorten it to change the note.
oneStarDescription: Blow one note on the cut straw.
twoStarDescription: Shorten it and say whether the note moved.
threeStarDescription: Say which length was easier.

title: Make a tassel
description: Make a tassel, bind the head, and show the skirt hanging.
oneStarDescription: Cut or wrap a bundle. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can make a bundle.
twoStarDescription: Tie the head so the skirt hangs.
threeStarDescription: Trim the ends so they hang together, or say you left them uneven on purpose.
